title: Comprehensive structural and electrical characterization of lithium metavanadate for advanced lithium-ion battery cathodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32248-32262

Lithium metavanadate (LiVO3) is a material of growing interest due to its monoclinic C2/c structure, which supports efficient lithium-ion diffusion through one-dimensional channels.
